purpose: Deep per-model/per-generation flipper dossiers. This is AUTOHAWK's structured car knowledge base, not a generic score list.
rules: A model is not enough: generation, engine and gearbox decide the deal.
Cheap cosmetic problems can be opportunity; engine/gearbox/documents/structural rust can kill profit.
Market price is only useful inside the same generation, engine family and mileage band.
If exact engine is unknown, reduce confidence and ask before visiting.

segments.name: Golf 4
segments.why_it_sells: Still known and liquid at the very bottom of the market, especially with long TUV and simple engines. But buyers expect cheap price.
segments.buyer_exit: Budget daily, first cheap car, diesel commuter, old VW fans.
segments.mileage_policy: Age/rust matters more than mileage. Petrol over 200k only very cheap. 1.9 TDI can run high mileage but rust/turbo/clutch decide.
body_risks: rust on sills, arches, floor and door bottoms

engines.name: 1.6 SR/MPI petrol
engines.notes: Best simple petrol story for Golf 4.

engines.name: 1.4 petrol
engines.notes: Weak; buy only cheap with TUV.

engines.name: 1.8T
engines.notes: Enthusiast/tuning risk. Not normal first-car stock.

engines.name: 1.9 TDI
engines.notes: Excellent reputation but only if rust/TUV/turbo/clutch are good.

engines.name: old automatic
engines.notes: Old automatic must be tested hot/cold.

segments.name: Golf 5
segments.why_it_sells: Huge buyer pool, familiar VW badge, still cheap but looks modern enough. Variant/Kombi adds practical demand.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyers, first car, cheap daily, small family, budget commuters.
segments.mileage_policy: Petrol above 190k only cheap with TUV and service. Diesel can be higher but DPF/turbo/clutch/rust matter.

engines.name: 1.6 MPI
engines.notes: Best Golf 5 petrol flip profile. Simple enough, easy buyer story.

engines.name: 1.4 petrol
engines.notes: Weak but acceptable if cheap and TUV is long.

engines.name: 1.4 TSI
engines.notes: Chain/oil/turbo fear. Not a strong flip without invoice proof.

engines.name: 1.9 TDI
engines.notes: Durable reputation, but age, turbo, clutch/DMF and rust decide.

engines.name: DSG/DQ200
engines.notes: Mechatronic/clutch fear; no HOT without proof.

segments.name: Golf 6
segments.why_it_sells: Modern enough for young buyers, strong VW demand, but wrong engine/gearbox can ruin the deal.
segments.buyer_exit: First car with modern look, daily driver, small family.
segments.mileage_policy: Petrol turbo above 160-180k becomes risky. Simple petrol/diesel with proof only.

engines.name: 1.6 MPI
engines.notes: Safer Golf 6 petrol profile if real MPI/manual.

engines.name: 1.6 TDI
engines.notes: DPF/EGR/injector risk. Works only with proof and long TUV.

engines.name: 2.0 TDI
engines.notes: Liquid diesel, but repair reserve required.

engines.name: DSG/DQ200
engines.notes: No strong lead without gearbox proof.

segments.name: Golf 7
segments.why_it_sells: Very liquid modern VW. Good for buyer-service, but for flipping the buy price must be clearly below market.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyer with bigger budget, daily commuter, small family, parents buying safer modern first car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k preferred. 150-220k only with service/TUV and strong discount. DSG and diesel emissions need proof.
red_flags: high mileage diesel with no service

engines.name: 1.2/1.4 TSI EA211
engines.notes: Better than EA111, but service/turbo/oil proof still matters.

engines.name: 1.6 TDI
engines.notes: Good demand; check DPF/EGR/injectors and service.

engines.name: 2.0 TDI / GTD
engines.notes: Very saleable, but expensive repairs and tuning risk.

engines.name: DSG/DQ200/DQ250
engines.notes: Can sell, but not HOT without proof/test drive.

segments.name: Polo 9N
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap VW badge, low insurance, simple first-car image. Sells only if cheap and TUV is clear.
segments.buyer_exit: Budget beginner car, student daily, city car.
segments.mileage_policy: Above 180-200k weak unless very cheap with TUV. Rust, chain and cold start matter more than number alone.

engines.name: 1.2 3-cylinder
engines.notes: Liquid but chain/cold-start check is mandatory.

engines.name: 1.4 MPI
engines.notes: Preferred old Polo petrol engine for resale.

engines.name: old automatic
engines.notes: Old automatic reduces safe flip quality.

segments.name: Polo 9N3
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap, familiar, easy to sell as first car. Better looking than 9N but still old.
segments.buyer_exit: Beginner car, city daily, cheap commuter.
segments.mileage_policy: Good under 160k. Above 190k only cheap with TUV/service.

engines.name: 1.2 petrol
engines.notes: Good only if quiet and TUV/service are clear.

engines.name: 1.4/1.9 TDI
engines.notes: Good economy story but check turbo/clutch/diesel system.

segments.name: Polo 6R
segments.why_it_sells: One of the strongest first-car/youth cars in Germany. 5-door, TUV, Klima and clean stock condition sell quickly.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyers, first car, parents buying reliable-looking small VW.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k preferred. 150-200k can work with TUV/service. Petrol above 200k only very cheap.

engines.name: 1.6 TDI
engines.notes: DPF/EGR/injector risk. Buy only with proof.

engines.name: DSG/DQ200
engines.notes: No strong lead without DSG proof.

segments.name: Polo 6C
segments.why_it_sells: Modern small VW with strong youth demand. Great for buyer-service if price is clearly below market.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyer with bigger budget, first car, city commuter.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k preferred. 140-200k only with service/TUV and discount. DSG/TSI needs proof.

engines.name: 1.2/1.4 TSI EA211
engines.notes: Not automatic reject, but needs service/turbo/oil proof.

engines.name: 1.4 TDI
engines.notes: Economical but diesel emissions/turbo checks matter.

engines.name: DSG/DQ200
engines.notes: No strong lead without proof/test drive.

segments.name: Corsa C
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap insurance, cheap parts, known beginner car. But it is old, so buyers mainly pay for TUV and visible condition.
segments.buyer_exit: Low-budget first car buyer or someone needing cheap transport with TUV.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k is good only with proof. 140-210k acceptable if TUV and clean body. Above 210k only very cheap.

engines.name: 1.0 petrol
engines.notes: Weak and less desirable. Needs cheap price and clean test.

engines.name: 1.2 petrol
engines.notes: Good if chain is quiet and TUV is long.

engines.name: 1.3 CDTI
engines.notes: Diesel repair risk is too high unless proof/discount are strong.

segments.name: Corsa D
segments.why_it_sells: One of the main cheap first-car cars in Germany. Looks modern enough, parts are cheap, buyer pool is large.
segments.buyer_exit: Young first-car buyer, city commuter, budget family second car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k preferred. 140-190k okay with TUV/service. Over 200k only cheap and simple petrol. Diesel over 180k needs strong proof.

engines.name: 1.0 petrol
engines.notes: Only attractive when very cheap with TUV.

engines.name: 1.4 petrol
engines.notes: Best Corsa D resale profile if price is under market.

engines.name: 1.6 Turbo / OPC
engines.notes: Not normal beginner flip; abuse and insurance risk.

engines.name: Easytronic
engines.notes: Reject unless huge discount and proof.

segments.name: Corsa E
segments.why_it_sells: Newer shape, safer first-car story, easier to sell to young buyers if price is not retail.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyer with bigger budget, small commuter, parents buying first car for child.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 130k strong. 130-180k okay with service. Over 180k needs cheap price and clean simple petrol.

engines.name: 1.4 naturally aspirated petrol
engines.notes: Preferred Corsa E if not turbo and priced well.

engines.name: 1.0 Turbo
engines.notes: Needs service proof and clean turbo behavior.

engines.name: 1.4 Turbo
engines.notes: Can sell, but not a blind cheap flip.

segments.name: Fiesta Mk5
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap, easy to insure, simple first-car image. The buyer pays for TUV and clean condition, not prestige.
segments.buyer_exit: Low-budget beginner, student, cheap city transport.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k good if TUV. 150-210k okay cheap. Over 210k only very cheap with long TUV.

engines.name: 1.25 petrol
engines.notes: Best old Fiesta engine for resale.

segments.name: Fiesta Mk6
segments.why_it_sells: Strong cheap first-car competitor to Polo/Corsa. 1.25 petrol, TUV and Klima can move quickly.
segments.buyer_exit: Young first-car buyer, commuter, budget buyer wanting a newer-looking small car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k preferred. 140-190k okay with TUV/service. Over 200k only cheap simple petrol. EcoBoost over 120k without proof is dangerous.

engines.name: 1.25 petrol
engines.notes: Prime Fiesta target for first-car flip.

engines.name: 1.6 Ti-VCT petrol
engines.notes: Better power but smaller buyer pool than 1.25.

engines.name: 1.0 EcoBoost
engines.notes: Wet belt/cooling risk. No HOT without proof.

segments.name: Fiesta Mk7
segments.why_it_sells: Modern, attractive to young buyers, but mostly expensive. Needs real discount to be a flip.
segments.buyer_exit: Higher-budget first-car buyer, young commuter, parents buying safer modern car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 120k preferred. EcoBoost needs documented wet belt/service. Over 150k only with large discount.

engines.name: 1.0 EcoBoost
engines.notes: Needs wet belt proof, otherwise margin is fake.

segments.name: Focus Mk1
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap transport with good driving feel, but age limits buyer confidence.
segments.buyer_exit: Low-budget buyer needing TUV, student, cheap work car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k good only with proof. 150-220k cheap with TUV. Over 220k usually not worth attention.

engines.name: TDDi/TDCi diesel
engines.notes: Old diesel repairs can eat margin.

segments.name: Focus Mk2
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap, practical, comfortable enough and parts are affordable. Turnier/Kombi has strong utility demand.
segments.buyer_exit: Budget family, commuter, someone needing cheap Kombi with TUV.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 160k preferred. 160-220k okay if TUV/service. Over 220k only very cheap, especially petrol. Diesel needs proof.

segments.name: Focus Mk3
segments.why_it_sells: Modern enough, practical, good as family/commuter car. Turnier sells better than hatch when priced right.
segments.buyer_exit: Budget family, commuter, first family car, practical buyer.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k strong. 150-220k okay with TUV/service. EcoBoost needs proof even at lower mileage. Diesel over 180k must be cheap.

engines.name: 1.0 EcoBoost
engines.notes: Wet belt/cooling risk. No HOT without proof.

engines.name: 1.5/1.6 EcoBoost
engines.notes: Turbo/cooling risk and smaller buyer pool.

segments.name: Focus Mk4
segments.why_it_sells: Modern and desirable, but capital requirement is higher and discount must be real.
segments.buyer_exit: Family/commuter with higher budget, young buyer wanting newer car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 120k preferred. Over 150k only with large discount and proof. Not ideal for cheap first cash flip.

segments.name: Fabia I
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap VAG-based transport, practical and trusted enough when it has TUV.
segments.buyer_exit: Low-budget beginner, student, cheap commuter, small family if Combi.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k is good only with TUV. 150-220k okay if cheap. Above 220k needs long TUV and very low price.

engines.name: 1.2 HTP
engines.notes: Accept only cheap with clean cold start.

segments.name: Fabia II
segments.why_it_sells: Practical, cheap to run, especially good as Combi. Buyers like it when it is clean and has TUV.
segments.buyer_exit: First-car buyer, commuter, small family, practical budget buyer.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k preferred. 150-220k okay with TUV/service. TSI/DSG requires proof or no strong lead.

engines.name: 1.2 HTP
engines.notes: Not bad when cheap, but not top target.

engines.name: 1.6 MPI
engines.notes: Very good if price is right.

segments.name: Fabia III
segments.why_it_sells: Modern enough, cheap to run, good trust image. Combi is useful and saleable.
segments.buyer_exit: Young first-car buyer, commuter, small family, parents buying safe budget car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k strong. 140-200k okay with service/TUV. DSG/diesel needs proof and discount.

engines.name: 1.0 MPI
engines.notes: Best safe Fabia III beginner profile.

segments.name: Atos / Atos Prime
segments.why_it_sells: Very cheap transport with low running costs. Buyers care about TUV and whether it simply works.
segments.buyer_exit: Low-budget first car, city runabout, cheap second car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 130k good with TUV. 130-180k okay cheap. Over 180k only very cheap with long TUV.

segments.name: i10 PA
segments.why_it_sells: Cheap insurance, reliable image, easy city car. Good for first-car buyer who wants low risk.
segments.buyer_exit: Student, beginner driver, city commuter, second car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 120k preferred. 120-180k okay with TUV/service. Over 180k only if cheap and clean.

segments.name: i10 IA
segments.why_it_sells: Modern small Hyundai with strong first-car demand and low repair fear.
segments.buyer_exit: Young first-car buyer, parents buying first car, city commuter.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 130k strong. 130-200k okay with TUV/service and price. Over 200k only cheap.

engines.name: automatic
engines.notes: Useful for city buyers but must test.

segments.name: i20 PB
segments.why_it_sells: Modern enough, practical, cheap to run, less repair fear than many old German cars.
segments.buyer_exit: First-car buyer, student, commuter, small family second car.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 150k preferred. 150-220k okay with TUV/service. Diesel needs proof and discount.

segments.name: i20 GB
segments.why_it_sells: Very solid modern first-car product. Good trust, good looks, cheap running costs.
segments.buyer_exit: Young buyer, parents buying first car, commuter with moderate budget.
segments.mileage_policy: Under 140k strong. 140-200k okay with service/TUV. Diesel/turbo needs proof.

engines.name: 1.9 CDTI

engines.name: CDTI diesel
engines.notes: DPF/EGR/turbo/clutch risk; no HOT without proof.

segments.mileage_policy: Can tolerate mileage, but clutch/exhaust/TÃœV decide.

engines.notes: Simple reliable engine; clutch is the common cost.
